title: Geometry-aware Incremental Neural Operator for Long-Horizon PDE prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.11237v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural operators have shown strong potential for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, long-horizon autoregressive prediction remains challenging: local errors accumulate as spectral inconsistency, phase misalignment, or mean drift. Existing methods mainly improve state representations and operator backbones, while leaving the repeatedly applied latent transition increment weakly structured, allowing spectral errors and unstable channel couplings to accumulate during rollout. To address these issues, we propose a geometry-aware incremental neural operator (GeoIncNO) for stable long-horizon PDE prediction. GeoIncNO predicts latent increments for residual advancement and uses lightweight low-rank projectors to regulate channel coupling within active frequency bands derived from the increment spectral energy distribution. tldr: 本文提出GeoIncNO，通过预测潜在增量并利用低秩投影器调控活跃频带的通道耦合，显著提升了长时程PDE预测的稳定性和准确性。
